rv.q: (And they now answer to Ben and Claude.) The fine Beatles-esque songs are courtesy of Green Day frontman Billie Joe Armstrong, who made his theatrical bones with American Idiot. The conceit is undeniably clever and the mod modernisation works pretty well.
"What’s notable is the enthusiasm and freshness playwright, director and an ebulliently gifted cast have brought to the task...Director Gay adds to the jokes with a variety of sight gags.
